texts:
Friday's notes are about usage: who earned the snaps and routes this week, team by team.

Denzel Boston ran 92 percent of Cleveland's routes Thursday night. Trade for him now; offer a bench WR.

Let's get into it.
#DawgPound

Denzel Boston played 95 percent of the snaps vs PIT and caught 4 for 89 on 7 targets.

Boston has 52 percent of Cleveland's air yards this season. WR46 rest of season for me, and the price is still a bench WR.
#DawgPound

Carnell Tate ran a route on 92 percent of the Titans' dropbacks vs NYG and drew 9 targets. WR35 for me @BAL, a low-end WR3. Trade for him; offer a bench WR.

Wan'Dale Robinson drew 11 targets. WR39 for me, a low-end flex play to a dart throw.
#TitanUp #RavensFlock

Roman Wilson scored on 3 catches for 74 at CLE, but he played 30 percent of the snaps and ran 40 percent of the routes.

WR104 rest of season for me. Don't chase the touchdown; monitor his route share in Week 5.
#HereWeGo #DawgPound

Mack Hollins leads New England with 16 targets in three games, and A.J. Brown's earliest return is Week 6.

Hollins is WR50 for me @BUF, a dart throw this week. Add him, 2 to 5 percent of FAAB.
#NEPats #BillsMafia

Rhamondre Stevenson took the passing downs and short yardage at JAX, 33 snaps to TreVeyon Henderson's 23. RB26 for me, a high-end RB3.

Henderson is RB28 for me, a high-end flex play with no passing-down role.
#NEPats

Ty Johnson took Buffalo's passing downs in Week 3: 15 snaps, 4 catches on 4 targets for 50.

James Cook drew 1 target but kept the early downs, 24 carries for 154. RB10 for me vs NE.

Johnson is outside my top 40 backs; sit him.
#BillsMafia #NEPats

Keaton Mitchell played 38 percent of the snaps in Week 3, 8 carries for 52, and is at 5.0 a carry. RB46 rest of season for me. Stash him, 2 to 4 percent of FAAB.

Omarion Hampton's snap share has gone 58, 63 and 42 percent. RB27 for me, a high-end RB3.
#BoltUp

Houston's backfield is close to even: about level in Week 1, then 42 to 38 and 34 to 20 in snaps.

David Montgomery is at 2.8 a carry. RB22 for me vs DAL, an RB2.

Woody Marks has 8 targets to Montgomery's 7. RB33 for me, a low-end RB3.
#HTownMade #DallasCowboys

Jake Ferguson's snap share has gone 76, 60 and 69 percent, and he has 11 targets on 105 throws. TE20 for me @HOU; sit him.

Ryan Flournoy is third on Dallas with 18 targets. Outside my top 50 receivers, a dart throw.
#DallasCowboys #HTownMade

Ashton Jeanty has 63 of the Raiders backs' 78 carries and 16 targets. RB9 for me vs KC.

Mike Washington Jr. has 15 carries for 102 and his coach has twice said he earned more work. RB43 rest of season for me. Stash him, 1 to 3 percent of FAAB.
#RaiderNation #ChiefsKingdom

Travis Kelce had 16 targets in Weeks 1 and 2, then 2 on 19 routes in Week 3. TE5 for me @LV.

Xavier Worthy drew 2 targets on 43 snaps. WR45 for me, a low-end flex play to a dart throw.
#ChiefsKingdom #RaiderNation

Michael Penix Jr. went 18 of 25 for 256 at GB, and Atlanta went 4 of 5 in the red zone.

Drake London caught 9 of 10 for 194. WR7 for me @NO.

Bijan Robinson got all five carries inside the 5. RB2 for me.
#DirtyBirds #Saints

Kyle Pitts Sr. has 6 targets in three games for Atlanta. TE22 for me, outside my top 12; sit him.
#DirtyBirds

Chase Brown kept 13 of the 16 Cincinnati back carries at PIT on 40 snaps. RB8 for me vs JAX.

Samaje Perine took 3 of the 5 back targets on 18 snaps. Outside my top 40 backs; sit him.
#WhoDey #DUUUVAL

Brian Thomas Jr. was on the field for 23 of 62 snaps vs NE and comes off it in two-tight-end sets. Outside my top 50 receivers @CIN; sit him.

Parker Washington is WR8 for me this week.
#DUUUVAL #WhoDey

Isaiah Likely's snap share has gone 49, 69 and 84 percent, with 22 routes on 27 dropbacks in Week 3. TE9 for me vs ARI.

Najee Harris replaced Devin Singletary as the Giants' No. 2 back. Outside my top 40 backs; sit him.
#NYGiants #BirdGang

Matthew Golden ran 44 routes on 55 dropbacks vs ATL, the same as Christian Watson, and has 12 targets. WR19 for me @TB, a WR2.

Tucker Kraft ran 71 percent of the routes. TE11 for me, a borderline start this week.
#GoPackGo #GoBucs

Ted Hurst III has played 75, 74 and 75 percent of Tampa's snaps. Outside my top 50 receivers, a dart throw.

Emeka Egbuka has 13 catches for 141 on 20 targets. WR34 for me vs GB, a low-end WR3.

Payne Durham played 55 percent of the snaps in Week 3; sit him.
#GoBucs

Kalif Raymond has 21 targets and a team-high 214 yards for Chicago with the backups at quarterback. WR47 for me vs NYJ, a low-end flex play to a dart throw.
#DaBears #JetUp

Aaron Jones Sr. has 78 percent of Minnesota's carries and a 24 percent target share since Jordan Mason went on IR. RB13 for me vs MIA, borderline RB1/RB2 this week.
#Skol #PhinsUp

Every note from today is on the Pass page, and the refreshed Menu and Prep Notes are on the site.

Follow @FF_ChefHazy for every call through Sunday, and like this if it sorted out your lineup.
